periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Approximately 45 degrees downward slope relative to the horizontal facial axis towards the snout.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Significant gap of white pixels separating the two dark semicircular regions across the cranial crown.
